track: Generative AI & Vision for Image PMs
note: Learner: Senior PM at Amazon working on image evaluation/classification/generation. Prior coverage (from earlier study plans): ML metrics (precision/recall/F1/AUC), neural network basics, transformer/attention concept, LLM basics. Knows CLIP only briefly. Lessons should recap fast, not re-teach.

lessons.title: Recap sprint: how models learn
lessons.focus: loss, gradient descent, train/val/test, overfitting — 10-min refresher framed around an image classifier

lessons.title: Recap sprint: metrics for image tasks
lessons.focus: precision/recall/F1 applied to image moderation; confusion matrices; why accuracy lies on imbalanced image datasets

lessons.title: How computers see: pixels, tensors, channels
lessons.focus: images as arrays, RGB channels, resolution vs information, normalization

lessons.title: Convolutions and CNNs
lessons.focus: filters, feature maps, hierarchy from edges to objects; why CNNs ruled vision for a decade

lessons.title: Classic CNN families you'll hear in meetings
lessons.focus: ResNet, EfficientNet — skip connections, scaling, what 'backbone' means

lessons.title: Embeddings: the core currency of your job
lessons.focus: vectors, cosine similarity, embedding space intuition, why 'similar images are nearby'

lessons.title: Vision Transformers (ViT)
lessons.focus: patches as tokens, attention over patches, ViT vs CNN trade-offs, when each wins

lessons.title: CLIP, properly this time
lessons.focus: contrastive learning, image-text pairs, shared embedding space, zero-shot classification

lessons.title: Zero-shot vs fine-tuned classification
lessons.focus: when CLIP zero-shot is enough, when to fine-tune, linear probes, cost/quality trade-off

lessons.title: Building an image classification product
lessons.focus: taxonomy design, label ambiguity, inter-annotator agreement, threshold picking as a PM decision

lessons.title: Object detection and segmentation
lessons.focus: bounding boxes vs masks, YOLO/DETR/SAM at concept level, mAP and IoU metrics

lessons.title: Image quality and similarity metrics
lessons.focus: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS, perceptual vs pixel metrics, near-duplicate detection

lessons.title: Datasets, labeling, and data flywheels
lessons.focus: labeling ops, active learning, synthetic data, dataset bias in image collections

lessons.title: Week review + self-quiz
lessons.focus: synthesis of days 1-13 with a 15-question self-test and answers

lessons.title: Generative models: the landscape
lessons.focus: GANs vs VAEs vs diffusion vs autoregressive — one map, what won and why

lessons.title: Diffusion models part 1: the core idea
lessons.focus: noise and denoising, forward/reverse process, intuition without math

lessons.title: Diffusion part 2: latent diffusion
lessons.focus: why generate in latent space, VAE encoder/decoder role, Stable Diffusion architecture

lessons.title: Text conditioning and guidance
lessons.focus: how prompts steer generation, cross-attention, CFG scale, negative prompts

lessons.title: The modern image-gen stack
lessons.focus: SDXL, FLUX, Imagen, DALL-E lineage; DiT (diffusion transformers); what differentiates them

lessons.title: Sampling, steps, and schedulers
lessons.focus: why step count matters, distillation and few-step models, latency/quality/cost triangle

lessons.title: Controlling generation
lessons.focus: ControlNet, inpainting, outpainting, image-to-image, IP-Adapter — the PM's control toolbox

lessons.title: Fine-tuning image generators
lessons.focus: LoRA, DreamBooth, textual inversion — brand styles and subject consistency

lessons.title: Evaluating generated images
lessons.focus: FID, CLIP score, human preference evals, ELO arenas — why eval is the hardest PM problem

lessons.title: Prompt-image alignment and faithfulness
lessons.focus: attribute binding failures, counting, text rendering, compositionality benchmarks

lessons.title: Safety for image generation
lessons.focus: NSFW filters, watermarking (C2PA/SynthID), IP and likeness risk, red-teaming image models

lessons.title: Multimodal LLMs part 1
lessons.focus: how GPT-4V/Claude/Gemini see images: vision encoder + projector + LLM

lessons.title: The VLM landscape: architectures and major players
lessons.focus: the three broad families — adapter-based (frozen vision encoder + projector bolted onto an LLM, LLaVA-style), natively multimodal transformers (image and text trained together from the start, Gemini/GPT-4o-class), and unified tokenization (image patches as tokens in one sequence, Chameleon-style); open families to know (LLaVA, Qwen-VL, InternVL, PaliGemma) vs closed (GPT-4V/4o, Gemini, Claude); a mental map for placing any new model announcement into one of these buckets

lessons.title: Multimodal LLMs part 2: VQA and image reasoning
lessons.focus: captioning, OCR, chart reading, using MLLMs as image classifiers and judges

lessons.title: Staying current on VLM progress
lessons.focus: the benchmark landscape (MMMU, MMBench, MathVista) and what each actually measures; release cadence and what 'state of the art' means in a field that moves monthly; how to read a model or system card in 5 minutes; a repeatable process for separating real capability jumps from marketing, since specific numbers age fast but the method doesn't

lessons.title: Week review + self-quiz
lessons.focus: synthesis of days 15-29 with a 15-question self-test and answers

lessons.title: LLM-as-judge for image evaluation
lessons.focus: using MLLMs to grade images at scale, rubric design, agreement with humans, failure modes

lessons.title: Building eval sets that predict launch success
lessons.focus: golden sets, slice analysis, regression testing for model updates

lessons.title: Vector databases and image search
lessons.focus: ANN search, HNSW at concept level, building 'find similar' features

lessons.title: Serving vision models in production
lessons.focus: GPU vs CPU inference, batching, quantization, cost per 1K images math

lessons.title: Latency and cost trade-offs as PM decisions
lessons.focus: model size tiers, cascades (cheap model first), caching strategies

lessons.title: Video generation and understanding
lessons.focus: Sora-class models, temporal consistency, video classification basics

lessons.title: 3D and beyond
lessons.focus: NeRF, Gaussian splatting, text-to-3D at awareness level

lessons.title: Reading a vision paper in 20 minutes
lessons.focus: how to skim arXiv cs.CV: abstract, figures, tables, what to ignore

lessons.title: Talking to your scientists
lessons.focus: questions that expose real trade-offs; how to challenge eval claims credibly

lessons.title: Roadmapping an image AI product
lessons.focus: build vs API, model refresh cadence, data moats, competitive teardown framework

lessons.title: Capstone part 1: design an image classification system
lessons.focus: end-to-end exercise: taxonomy, data, model choice, metrics, thresholds

lessons.title: Capstone part 2: design an image generation feature
lessons.focus: end-to-end exercise: model choice, controls, evals, safety, cost model

lessons.title: Final review and what to learn next
lessons.focus: full-course synthesis, gaps to fill, how to stay current using the daily news digest (including the new Markets and India sections)
